summary: CureFlow Phase 1 MVP — comprehensive backend (pytest, 39 tests) + frontend (Playwright) testing completed. All 39 backend API tests pass (100%). All major frontend routes load correctly: Login, Dashboard (6 stat cards, trend chart, departments, missed-revenue panel, lead pipeline, sources), WhatsApp Inbox (conv list + thread + AI Draft + Summarize + Note + quick templates), Patients (list + filters), Appointments, Follow-ups (Tasks), Missed Revenue (4 sections), Settings (WA creds + templates CRUD + users + audit log). Sidebar nav, Settings link visible for admin, Cmd+K command palette opens. Auth (admin/reception/marketing/staff) works; role-based access enforced (non-admin gets 403 on /auth/register, /settings/whatsapp POST, /audit-logs). AI integration (Claude Sonnet 4.5 via Emergent LLM) works — draft-reply and summarize both return valid responses. WhatsApp webhook verify works with token from env. Demo inbound message endpoint correctly creates patient + conversation + message, classifies urgency, and triggers awaiting_reply tracking.

minor.issue: No issues found in 39 endpoint tests.

issues: Recharts emits width(-1)/height(-1) warning on initial mount before container measures — visual rendering still correct after layout settles; consider giving ResponsiveContainer a minHeight or fixed aspect to silence the warning.

action_items: (Optional) Add minHeight/aspect to Recharts ResponsiveContainer on Dashboard to silence width(-1)/height(-1) warnings

(Optional) Add data-testid attributes to conversation list items, patient rows, and stat cards for more robust future testing (currently most interactive elements are reachable via text/role selectors but explicit data-testid would be best-practice)
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 893 lines — consider splitting into routers (auth, patients, conversations, appointments, tasks, dashboard) for maintainability once Phase 2 begins.
send_message endpoint correctly bypasses Meta when WA settings disabled and marks status='sent' (demo mode) — verified.
AI classify on every inbound message is inline-await; if traffic grows, push to background queue.
Verify token retrieval at /whatsapp/webhook prefers DB settings.verify_token then env — works as documented.
All ObjectId leaks handled via projection {_id:0} or _serialize helper — clean.
Audit log writes wrapped in try/except — won't break parent request on failure; good.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 7 routes render, login + nav + command palette verified)

test_credentials: admin@cureflow.in / admin123 (admin), reception@cureflow.in / reception123, marketing@cureflow.in / marketing123, staff@cureflow.in / staff123 — all working.
seed_data_creation: Test patients prefixed TEST_ were created during pytest run. Initial seed (12 patients, 5 conversations, 4 users) intact.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py is comprehensive and re-runnable (TEST_ prefixed data is idempotent via unique phone). AI tests have 60s timeout — Claude Sonnet 4.5 typically returns in 3-6 seconds. WhatsApp Cloud API real outbound NOT tested (bypassed via demo mode by design). To enable real WA send, populate /api/settings/whatsapp with phone_number_id+access_token+enabled=true.
